mechanism: Both drugs can cause hyperkalemia through different mechanisms: levofloxacin rarely causes hyponatremia/fluid retention, while irbesartan (ARB) reduces aldosterone, increasing potassium retention; additionally, levofloxacin may impair renal function which potentiates irbesartan's hyperkalemic effect.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function (creatinine, eGFR) before and during concurrent use; counsel patient on high-potassium foods and NSAIDs; ensure adequate hydration.
